reviews.text:
A homely and warm dog daycare with a wonderful team! ❤️

Practical matters have gone excellently; WA communication has been fast and we have received plenty of videos and other updates during the daycare. The schedules have been flexible for us and the rules and instructions have been clear. The care of our two different dogs has been present and dog-reading.

Special mentions for the fact that our dogs with a Molossian/power breed background have been just as welcome at the daycare as any other breed, and for how our little puppy received special attention on his daycare days and clearly enjoyed being at the daycare. ❤️

Our dachshund Onni received excellent and professional care throughout our holiday week. The daily messages and videos were a great source of joy. The icing on the cake was that the shy Onni perked up during the week of treatment and had a great time with his friends. Onni was able to enjoy her holiday and we enjoyed ours with great pleasure. I highly recommend SleepInn!
A reliable dog grooming salon. The owners take care of the dog with professionalism and heart. I recommend!
My dog ​​was injured in this horrible facility. He keeps dragging one leg when he walks as if it's in pain - something he's never done before. Stay away from this place.

I have taken my rat girl to SleepInn boarding several times and have been equally satisfied every time! The longest time has been two weeks when I was away, and it was the best when I didn't have to stress about chasing my dog ​​once during my vacation! The dog seemed to have even more fun in boarding than we did on our trip! 😆 The people who run the boarding are really lovely and take each dog's needs into account individually! I can't recommend it enough! 💖

Fiona our lab stayed at the SleepInn dog hotel for 5 nights while the rest of the family was on vacation. Before the overnight stay, we had a daycare trial. It was the first time Fiona was away from her family so we were a little worried about how she would cope. However, everything went well and our worries disappeared when we received daily pictures and videos and saw that the dog was doing well and enjoying herself and was in good hands 😊

Excellent dog care with great knowledge and skill.
All the needs and feelings of a sensitive dog were taken into account and the communication was great!

The owners took 1200 euros for my dogs care and then literally made me beg for snapshots of my dog. First day of care they sent nice updates, after that the updates became less and less frequent and shorter and when I asked to send me one picture of my beloved dog per day they called me 'bossy and demanding'. They also complained about things like my puppy missing the pad or pooping inside after being locked for too long and asked for my cooperation how to solve the problem, but when I started communicating to them they told me they don't have time to chat with me. These people are toxic and fussy beyond anything I've seen and I really regret placing my dog with them. This place is only suitable for old calm dogs. Update: today I received a message from the owners that I need to collect my dog in 48 hrs or they will put her in animal shelter. The reason is that they don't consider her to be house trained. Please note that my dog is house trained and they were informed beforehand that she might poop inside of her pen if left alone for too long. It was absolutely fine with them until the payment of 1200 euros was made. Since their notice it was not possible to reach out to them, they are ignoring all my messages. Stay away from these fraudsters and by no means book a prolonged stay for your dog there.
I have used Sleepinn for my dog's nail trimming and coat washing. I can recommend it. The owners of the company are really nice and I can leave my dog ​​in their care with complete peace of mind. 😊 …

SleepInn has been an excellent daycare for our sensitive dog. We gradually got to know the facility and staff on our dog's terms, and the staff was excellent at taking our dog's special needs into account from the start.

While our dog is in care, we receive videos and pictures of the day's events. Communication with the daycare is excellent during treatment periods and when booking new appointments. Our dog clearly feels safe with the staff and is happy to return to the care.
A very reliable and responsible dog daycare! My dog ​​had a great time and I was kept very well informed. A very good experience and we will be happy to bring our dog here for care in the future!

The dog clearly enjoys himself at SleepInn, he is super enthusiastic when he realizes where he is going. :) Both the daycare visits and the hotel accommodation have gone well. The facilities are comfortable, the dog's needs are taken into account and you can get updates on WhatsApp during the treatment. I recommend it!
Thanks for the review!
Wonderful place. Nala is absolutely thrilled to be with Mars, Salla and Arvid. We couldn't have asked for anything better. We highly recommend it! Thank you Salla, Arvid and Mars.
Thanks for the review!

Our puppy was cared for at SleepInn for a week during our trip. We were really happy with Roni's care. Every day we received WA messages and videos, which showed that our dog was happy. He got to play with other dogs, which is not possible at home. He was played with and also taught "dog manners". As a puppy, Roni was allowed to spend the nights with the caregivers, which allowed him to have a home-like environment at night. We plan to use the services of the daycare again.

Our dog had a great stay there and the owners keep us up to date sending us photos and videos and a text update of how the day was.

It was great to see how after a few days of initial stress (our dog usually has issues socializing) was able to play together with other dogs.

Only issue for us is that it was a bit far from where we live but they do offer a taxi pickup service.

The care place was pleasant and spacious. The female caregiver was a good fit for our dog, but the male caregiver did not tolerate her because she had been abused by a man, but after a couple of days of care, a negative message came out, even though we had visited and had talked about the dog's behavior, etc. When I came to pick it up, I felt that my dog ​​was not suitable for their care.
Thanks for the review!

Our dog (now 8 months old) has been visiting the daycare a few times a month for about 3 months and has also stayed overnight a couple of times. Isla enjoys the daycare immensely, she is always eager to get back. :) Salla is a gentle and firm professional, in whose hands Isla not only enjoys herself, but also learns and develops with every visit. At SleepInn, Isla has also learned pack behavior, which she cannot learn at home (she is the only dog). During the day, we always receive pictures and videos and information about the day. What a wonderful place!

A warm recommendation for the SleepInn hotel in Koivuha, Tikkurila. We first went there to get to know the premises with our dog and he also spent a couple of hours in daycare there shortly before his hotel holiday.
Our almost 15-year-old deaf Westie spent two weeks at the hotel while our family was on holiday. Rocky had his own room, where we brought familiar and safe supplies, including his own bed and transport box where he could sleep and rest at home, which had their own homely scents.
Senior Rocky received really good care and probably made new friends during his holiday.
We received a daily WA message and a picture or video of our dog's progress. You could see from them that he was having a great time.
The owners Salla and Arvid are top guys, a heartfelt thank you for the wonderful care of our deaf senior!! We will definitely return when we need a place to stay, if Rocky has enough health and years to live.
Our young cocker spaniel has been to daycare at SleepInn several times, sometimes for long days. They have been very flexible with the care times here. …
Thanks for the review!
Very satisfied with the service. The dog also enjoyed the two-day treatment.

Everything went well, although we would have liked a more detailed written reminder before the visit on how to prepare, e.g. the vaccination card, which is important to bring. The dog was taken care of very well. We received pictures and …
Sakke has been to the hotel twice. First for one day and then for 3 days in the fall. …
Thanks for the review!

This was our dog's second time in care, but certainly not the last. We are very happy with the "homelike" care and activities with other dogs our dog received, as well as the daily messages we received. Thank you very much! 🧡 …

Tino's first experience at daycare was here! 😍 We were happy with the daycare. It was nice to receive pictures and messages about Tino's day during the day 🙂 The day sounded active, we went outside and played during the day! Thank you ❤️ …
